rules.title: Causal auto-regressive forecasting
rules.summary: Earth4D learns spatio-temporal distributions via causal auto-regressive model forecasting future states from past states.

rules.title: Absolute and relative encoders
rules.summary: Earth4D pairs an absolute GPS/time NeRF-like encoder with a relative limited-context 4D LSTM-like encoder.

rules.title: Positional encodings fused per-token
rules.summary: Earth4D positional encodings must be trained and fused with every token in each batch's context window.

rules.title: Retain CUDA kernel speed
rules.summary: Earth4D must stay at least as fast as current production NVIDIA-origin CUDA kernels.

rules.title: Capability over parameter count
rules.summary: Measure Earth4D by held-out capability; prefer smallest model meeting current benchmark means; scale only when capability improves.

rules.title: Parallelizable memory and compute
rules.summary: Earth4D architecture must allow concurrent processing of multiple geography/time subsets at scale.

rules.title: Per-species embeddings share topology
rules.summary: Phylogenomic network preserves per-species embeddings that share processing topologically per evolutionary history.

rules.title: Self-supervised from scientific trees
rules.summary: Phylogenomic species network must be self-supervised, based entirely on scientifically-derived phylogenetic trees.

rules.title: Projectable embedding for unknowns
rules.summary: Phylogenomic embedding space must admit projection of new species with unknown tree-of-life position.

rules.title: Learnable in-context neighbor updates
rules.summary: Species network is learnable: in-context species and neighboring species update every batch.

rules.title: Neighbor embedding propagation
rules.summary: A batch with only Species A must update embeddings of neighbor species B, C, ..., n-th neighbor.

rules.title: Fast phylogenomic gather-update
rules.summary: Species network gather and update must become extremely fast, likely via optimized CUDA.

rules.title: Token context window fusion
rules.summary: Core multi-modal fusion inputs a context window of tokens 1..T.

rules.title: Token composition four encodings
rules.summary: Each token combines Earth4D encoding, phylogenomic encoding, modality-specific encoding, and learnable modality-type nn.Embedding.

rules.title: Mask-as-query with memory
rules.summary: PerceiverIO-style masking of tokens as querying; attend over full window plus accessible long-term memory.

rules.title: Joint distribution modeling
rules.summary: Representation must simultaneously model joint distributions of all variables, Hinton/DBM-inspired generative multi-modal modeling.

rules.title: MADE-style Bayesian posterior
rules.summary: Train as Bayesian probabilistic model: unmasking additional evidence yields most-likely posterior system state.

rules.title: All modalities always included
rules.summary: Ingest every prepared modality; a modality hurting benchmarks is an integration bug, never a drop reason.

rules.title: Minimize files and tokens
rules.summary: Express the system in fewest files/tokens on the mutable critical-path surface; quantify and shrink it each pass.

rules.title: Fixed 2291-step budget
rules.summary: Every comparable experiment runs exactly 2,291 optimizer steps, seeds 1337/1338, with seed-matched controls.

rules.title: Efficiency without math change
rules.summary: Optimize kernels, fusion, compilation, memory without changing per-step math; verify exactness; report time/params/VRAM.

rules.title: Iterative multi-modal diffusion decoding
rules.summary: Reconstruct all variables jointly over K refinement rounds through the shared latent bottleneck; even observed states revisable.

rules.title: Preserve per-variable marginals
rules.summary: Each variable keeps own channel and decoder; cross-modal flow only via O(N·L) latent highway, never O(N²).

rules.title: Dense 4D field modeling
rules.summary: Infer most-likely embedding of every variable at every space-time patch, pinning observations, matching sensor resolutions.

rules.title: Maskable phylogenomic embedding
rules.summary: Species' phylogenomic embedding is a maskable, reconstructable MADE state; randomly withhold per batch and reconstruct.

rules.title: Frozen BioCLIP text seed
rules.summary: Seed species embeddings from frozen BioCLIP 2.5 text embeddings via a small learned probe; compute once per species per batch.

rules.title: Bidirectional plant-pollinator induction
rules.summary: Model interactions as bilinear form between two separately phylo-refined trees so one pair propagates both ways.

rules.title: No fuzzy science grounding
rules.summary: Every component fit to real data or a frozen SOTA foundation embedding; no unvalidated priors or heuristics.

rules.title: Exact tree-GP clade attention
rules.summary: Refine species graph via exact OU tree-GP O(N) message passing on internal clade nodes; LatentCladeAttention unifies out-of-tree.

rules.title: Champion before-after reporting
rules.summary: Every champion commit runs champion_report.py, states BEFORE->AFTER scores per benchmark; no metric may regress.

rules.title: Detached heads, inviolable core
rules.summary: Heads train on detached pooled latents by default; backprop allowed only via isolated trait-subspace with reliability weighting.

rules.title: Score full benchmark suite
rules.summary: Net score is harmonic mean over ALL benchmarks including renormalized deltas; champions carry the whole suite.

foundations.name: DINOv3
foundations.role: Vision encoder embedding iNaturalist, NAIP, Sentinel-2 imagery (SAT493M variant for satellite).

foundations.name: CLAY v1.5
foundations.role: Open geospatial foundation model vision encoder for satellite imagery.

foundations.name: GraphCast
foundations.role: GNN causal spatio-temporal simulator inspiration (deterministic weather forecasting).

foundations.name: GenCast
foundations.role: GNN probabilistic spatio-temporal simulator inspiration (probabilistic weather forecasting).

foundations.name: JEPA (I-JEPA)
foundations.role: Joint-embedding predictive architecture inspiring embedding-space masked prediction fusion.

foundations.name: Perceiver IO
foundations.role: Latent-bottleneck architecture inspiring mask-as-query multi-modal fusion.

foundations.name: Deep Boltzmann Machines (Srivastava & Salakhutdinov)
foundations.role: Hinton-lineage joint multi-modal distribution modeling inspiration (rule 16).

foundations.name: MADE
foundations.role: Masked autoencoder for distribution estimation; basis of Bayesian posterior training (rule 17).

foundations.name: BioCLIP / BioCLIP 2 / 2.5
foundations.role: Tree-of-life foundation model; frozen 2.5 ViT-H 1024-d text embeddings seed species representations (rule 26).

foundations.name: LP-FT
foundations.role: Evidence that naive fine-tuning distorts pretrained geometry; justifies frozen-prior-plus-probe design.
